title: I found the developer command in my Roblox town... Part 2

lines.text: Last time, I found the developer command, and my whole Roblox town disappeared.
So I walked around. Nobody. Not even the kid who spams L in the chat.
The whole server was frozen. Gray. Silent. Just me.
So I went into the rich kid's mansion, and I sat on his golden throne.
Best day of my life. For about ten seconds. Being rich is boring when nobody is there to see it.
So I went back to the computer. It said, developer console unlocked. Type any command.
But of course, I got the free trial. Three commands. Low quality mode.
My first command was slash spawn house. Because my family lives on a spawn pad.
It spawned a house. The size of a shoebox.
I could fit exactly one foot inside.
Two commands left. So I typed, slash bring everyone back.
And it worked! Every single player in town came back.
But the free trial only had one outfit saved. Mine.
Everybody spawned in a gray shirt with patches on it. Even the mayor. Even the giant kid.
The richest kid in town looked down at his shirt and said, why do I look broke?
He offered me one million Robux to fix it. My dad makes that in two thousand years.
So I used my last command. Slash undo.
The screen said, sorry. Undo is a premium feature.
Then the whole town turned around and looked at me. Slowly.
So I ran. I didn't stop until I got to the Robux mine, where my dad works.
But Dad wasn't mining. He was sitting at a secret computer behind the rocks.
And on his screen, it said, developer, logged in.
My dad wasn't a miner. He made the whole game.
He said, son, I gave you slash jump on purpose. It's the only command that keeps getting stronger.
I was about to ask why we live on a spawn pad if he owns the entire game.
Then every screen in town flashed red. Server shutting down in ten seconds.
Dad's face went white. He whispered, son, that's not me.
Part three if this gets a thousand likes.
